crossRefs.note: Jonathan said to David, “Come! Let’s go out into the field.” They both went out into the field.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

translations.web: Jonathan said to David, “Come! Let’s go out into the field.” They both went out into the field.
translations.bsb: “Come,” he replied, “let us go out to the field.” So the two of them went out into the field,
translations.kjv: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.
translations.asv: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.
